item.title: The August 2026 Eclipse: From the Artic to Spain
item.description: A total eclipse crosses Greenland, Iceland and northern Spain on August 12th. Madrid and Barcelona miss it by a sliver.

item.title: The Lobito Corridor: Where Africa's Copper Flows
item.description: A US and EU backed railway revives an Atlantic Route for Central Africa's precious minerals, racing a Chinese backed line to the Indian Ocean.

item.title: Crisis in the Red Sea: War Zones and Trade Routes
item.description: Houthi attacks near the Bab-el-Mandeb strait pushed global shipping onto a 10-day detour around Africa.

item.title: Renewable Energy: Stop Orders on the East Coast's Shores
item.description: A federal lease line off Rhode Island became 65 standing turbines - halted twice by executive order, reinstated twice by federal courts.
